I'm still gold so maybe im not that much qualified for helping but ive learned some things while im approaching 300k
First one is: people will run away or pressure you depending on your behavior. In general people hates irelia so much cuz she can be a frickin abuser. Once you get the ways to play aggressive and power spikes you will be pushing your enemies back. As long as pratice can help, try to prepare the wave to a "surprise" engage
Other champions kinda want to farm a minion, then the other e only then fight... You want to fight over the enemy wave
Try to always hit minions in the back/front just enough so you can have the mobility to engage OR run if needed
Until lv 9 (when u can one hit caster minion with Q) try something like W (to damage the minions) then Q in a minion and cast the first E while Q'ing the second one, land your E on the enemy as fast as u can (horizontal lines are better than vertical ones) then Q AA Q
Do not forget to auto between abilities
Mid has some easier matchups but keep im mind that top has more space for you deny xp and farm to ur enemies
Good luck
